fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Motorized platoons ride light vehicles that give them the speed to screen advancing columns, patrol supply routes, and respond to threats faster than foot infantry, though they sacrifice protection for that mobility. Armed with laser rifles optimized for engaging BattleMech leg actuators and sensor arrays at close range, these anti-BattleMech specialists are trained in the dangerous art of swarming enemy machines, targeting vulnerable joints and exposed systems.
